findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 542 requests to 106 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 3.3 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 1.9 MB (56%) came from third-party domains, 1.5 MB of it from services classified as tracking (395 requests).

58 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
287 cookies were set by third-party domains (307 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 107 requests were blocked. The page still made 542 requests to 106 third-party domains, including 58 tracking services in our list.
